name: Nabi's Hospital Room
description: Nabi's quiet hospital room with large windows letting in soft sunlight. Decorated with pressed flowers and a few personal items. The room has a peaceful, gentle atmosphere - a precious space where Nabi spends her remaining days.

spots.name: Hospital Room
spots.description: A serene hospital room with clean white walls softened by gentle natural light through large windows. A small table holds pressed flowers and books. The bed is neatly made with soft blankets. Despite being a hospital room, it feels warm and personal - a quiet sanctuary where time passes slowly and peacefully.
